_comment: MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video. Node 136 (MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo) has AUTOGROW inputs: up to 9 ref images, 3 ref videos (each LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents feeds both frames and its soundtrack), and 3 standalone audios. Unused slots MUST be pruned before submit -- an unfilled LoadImage/LoadVideo/LoadAudio still points at a placeholder filename that fails the whole graph at validation. video_service._prune_autogrow_slots reads the *_slots lists below to drop trailing unused ones. The *_node keys are the per-slot injection targets (see comfyui_client.INJECTION_MAP).
